lines.text: Many learners say: I am boring.
Bored is a feeling. Boring is the thing.

data.why: Bored is a feeling. Boring is the thing.

quiz.stem: The film is ___. I am tired.

native.tip: bored 表示人的感受，boring 表示事物让人觉得无聊。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I am boring.”？😅 说自己无聊要用 bored，boring 描述的是事物：“I am bored.”。跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。

en.tip: Bored is how you feel. Boring describes the thing that bores you.
en.caption: Do you say “I am boring.”? 😅 Bored is how you feel; boring describes the thing: “I am bored.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
